mapper.update: UPDATE t_refund_order SET status = #{status}, status_type = #{statusType}, success_at = CASE WHEN #{success} THEN COALESCE(success_at, NOW()) WHEN #{status} = 'PROCESSING' THEN NULL ELSE success_at END, terminal_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL') THEN COALESCE(terminal_at, NOW()) WHEN #{status} = 'PROCESSING' THEN NULL ELSE terminal_at END WHERE refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId} AND CHAR_LENGTH(refund_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{refundOrderId}) AND CAST(refund_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(#{refundOrderId} AS BINARY(256)) AND status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE t_refund_order SET status = 'PROCESSING', status_type = 'warn', success_at = NULL, terminal_at = NULL, channel_code = NULL, channel_refund_no = NULL, channel_submitted_at = NULL WHERE refund_order_id = #{refundOrderId} AND CHAR_LENGTH(refund_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{refundOrderId}) AND CAST(refund_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(#{refundOrderId} AS BINARY(256)) AND status = 'FAIL'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_refund_operation_log ( log_no, refund_order_id, refund_attempt_no, action_code, action_name, from_status, to_status, operator_name, operation_remark, created_at ) VALUES ( #{logNo}, #{refundOrderId}, #{refundAttemptNo}, #{actionCode}, #{actionName}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorName}, #{operationRemark}, NOW() )
